1. About these terms

This website is operated by Harmono Pvt. Ltd. under the brand Builds Your Mind. By using the website or sending an enquiry, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

2. Information on the website

We try to keep programme descriptions, product information and contact details accurate. Education programmes and kits can change, so the website is a general guide rather than a binding offer. The written quotation or order confirmation we send you is the authoritative description of scope, price and deliverables.

We do not guarantee a particular learning outcome, rank, admission result or exam score. Programme content is matched to the class group and the time available.

3. Enquiries and quotations

Submitting an enquiry does not create a contract. A contract is formed only when both sides confirm the scope, dates, price and payment terms in writing. We may decline an enquiry where the requested date, location or scope cannot be delivered properly.

Quotations are valid for the period stated in the quotation. If no period is stated, please ask us to reconfirm before relying on it.

4. Products, prices and availability

Product pages may show a price, a bulk price or “price on request”. Prices can change and availability is confirmed at the time of order. Where a product is listed without a price, the current price is provided in the quotation.

Images are illustrative. Kit contents, packaging and component brands may change where necessary, provided the educational purpose and agreed specifications are maintained.

5. Delivery, warranty, replacement and refunds

Delivery timelines, shipping charges, warranty periods, replacement terms and refund/cancellation terms are confirmed in writing in the quotation or order confirmation before payment. Please read that document before confirming an order.

Where a product arrives damaged or incomplete, contact us promptly with photographs and the order reference so we can arrange a replacement or another remedy under the agreed terms. Consumable components and damage caused by misuse may be excluded.

Workshop and programme cancellation or rescheduling terms are confirmed in the programme proposal. If a session has to be moved because of weather, a school closure or a similar event, we will work with you to find a new date.

This website does not currently take online payments. Payment instructions are shared separately in writing after an order or programme is confirmed. Do not send money to any account that has not been confirmed by our team through an official channel.
